senses.gloss: (b. h. שׂוּט)to move about, be unsteady, v. סָטָה.
to shake; to swing (v. הֶיסֵּט), contrad. to נגע to touch directly.
units: Zab. V, 1 המַסִּיט את הזב או שהזב מַסִּיטוֹ he who moves a zab (v. זָב) (by shaking the board on which he stands) or whom the zab moves.

<cite ref="Chullin 124b:8">Ḥull. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>והִסִּיטָן</he> and shook them; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23">Ex. R. s. 23</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">Lev. R. s. 11</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">ib.</cite> s. 16 <he>הסיטן</he>, read <he>הטיסן</he>, v. <cite ref="I00189"><he>טוּס</he></cite> h.]
<cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 4:6">Tosef. Zab. IV, 6</cite> <he>אם היו נִיסּוֹטִין</he> if they moved (on account of his rapping, and did not merely vibrate).
<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 10:8">Tosef. Toh. X, 8</cite> [read:] <he>ובלבד שלא יהו ניסוטין וכ׳</he> provided they are not shaken up by the vibrations of the partition.
